name: contact-list-cleaner
description: Merge contact lists from several Excel/CSV files into one clean list: columns are mapped to one template, names, phone numbers (international format, +86 by default), emails and company names are normalised, sure duplicates (same phone or email) are merged automatically and likely duplicates are shown side by side for you to confirm. Exports Excel or CSV with a merge log and a list of invalid values. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded or looked up online.

description_i18n.en: Merge contact lists from several Excel/CSV files into one clean list: columns are mapped to one template, names, phone numbers (international format, +86 by default), emails and company names are normalised, sure duplicates (same phone or email) are merged automatically and likely duplicates are shown side by side for you to confirm. Exports Excel or CSV with a merge log and a list of invalid values. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded or looked up online.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把多个 Excel/CSV 客户名单合成一份干净的名单：字段映射到统一模板，规范姓名、手机号（国际格式，默认 +86）、邮箱和公司名；电话或邮箱相同的确定重复自动合并，可能重复左右对照交给你逐对确认。导出 Excel 或 CSV，附合并日志和无效值清单。全部本地处理，不上传、不联网查询。
